pages.title: Final Settlement
pages.text: Games usually start at 25000 points and return 30000, with agreed $(thing)uma$(0) (placement points).$(br2)The player with the most points at the end wins. If someone is busted (negative points), the game ends immediately and settlement still applies.

pages.title: Common Variants
pages.text: Rules differ from table to table:$(li)multiple ron: head bump or triple-ron draw;$(li)how strict kuikae is;$(li)how many red fives;$(li)whether 13+ han counts as a counted yakuman;$(li)whether nagashi mangan or nine terminals are used;$(li)whether four riichi, four winds or four kans abort the hand;$(li)whether the dealer may repeat at All Last and when the game extends.$(br2)Confirm before playing.

pages.title: Pao (Liability)
pages.text: $(thing)Pao$(0): if your call lets an opponent reach a yakuman that is clearly one tile away (such as daisangen or suukantsu), you may have to pay all or part of their win.$(br2)Whether pao applies, and how much it covers, depends on the table's rules; agree on it beforehand.
